name: kettlebell-dead-bug
instructions:
1. Setup in a supine position with your legs in a 90/90 position (90 degree bend at the hips and knees) while holding onto a kettlebell with the arms overhead.
2. Extend the one leg as you exhale.
3. Return back to the starting position and repeat on the opposite side.
4. Repeat for the desired number of total repetitions.
